name: amanda-bamford-hobby-site
description: Amanda Bamford's personal portfolio and making journal

scripts.check: node --check content/projects.js && node --check scripts/build.js && node --check scripts/render-projects.js && node --check scripts/serve.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler deploy --config wrangler.workers.json
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy ./dist
